summary: Rainier Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering (IPO) on August 28, 2026, following the effectiveness of its Form S-1. The company sold 7,500,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $75,000,000 in gross proceeds. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-quarter of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50. The underwriters have a 45-day over-allotment option for up to 1,125,000 additional units. Related agreements include an underwriting agreement with Chardan Capital Markets and a warrant agreement with Continental Stock Transfer Trust. This is a standard IPO event, not a special situation.
